aidokuWizard.sourcesReady: All required sources are installed. Continue to review your import.
aidokuWizard.previewHelp: These records can be added or merged. Nothing has been imported yet.
aidokuWizard.offlineHelp: Recover exact matching sources to read those titles. Records that cannot be restored are listed separately.
aidokuWizard.recoveryHelp: Your backup contains manga from sources that are not installed. Install the available matches to read them again. Nothing is installed until you approve.
aidokuWizard.exactHelp: Sources must match the exact ID from your backup. Source names are never used to guess. Your original backup is unchanged.
aidokuWizard.noMissing: No missing source IDs in this preview.
aidokuWizard.listError: Source lists could not be loaded. You can manage them in Source Lists.
aidokuWizard.preserveHelp: You can import now even if some sources are unavailable. Your saved library and supported reading progress and tracker bindings will be kept.
aidokuWizard.legacyHelp: Install matching sources before importing to avoid skipping their entries.
aidokuWizard.confirmHelp: Only the selected packages will be installed. Manga import still requires your separate confirmation after the new preview.
aidokuWizard.recheckError: Backup preview could not be rechecked.
aidokuWizard.installFailed: Could not install: {{names}}. You can retry these sources before importing.
aidokuWizard.installError: Some sources could not be installed. Recheck and retry remaining sources.
aidokuWizard.inactiveTrackerHelp: These trackers are not supported yet. Their associations are saved but will not sync.
aidokuWizard.savedWithoutSources: Library records from unavailable sources are preserved. Install the matching extensions to read those titles again.
aidokuWizard.sourceUnavailableHelp: Your library and saved progress are kept. Restore this source or transfer to another.
aidokuWizard.safeTransferHelp: Unverified page positions stay with the original manga. Partial transfers keep the original in your library.
